name: Truefold
summary: An identity-verification console with a live check conveyor, case review and a rule builder
about: A complete app for a trust and safety team that checks people's identity before an account opens. People travel a live conveyor through document, selfie and screening checks; each case opens with its pipeline lighting up step by step over a passport data page and a face-mesh scan. The checks, reviewers, data sources and decision rules are all editable, and every change lands in an audit log.
how: Watch people move along the live conveyor on the overview and see where others drop off in the funnel.
Open Verifications, filter by status and open a case; the check pipeline lights up and the selfie is scanned.
Approve, ask for new photos, escalate or reject with a reason, then jump to the next person in the queue.
Reorder the check pipeline by dragging the handles (or the arrow buttons), switch checks on or off and set thresholds.
Share the queue between online reviewers and set how many approvals get a second look.
Build a rule from conditions and an action; the simulator shows how many recent people it would match.
Turn data sources on or off, test them, watch latency update, and search the audit log.
